verdict.rationale: Langfuse documents several product-owned automations that run in the background once configured. Managed LLM-as-a-judge evaluators automatically score a sample of live production traces via rules. Scheduled blob-storage exports run on their own. Threshold alerts fire to Slack, GitHub Actions, or webhooks. These are fixed, purpose-specific automations rather than a general automation builder for agentic workflows. Missing for 10: general-purpose user-defined automation/workflow configuration, scheduling or triggering beyond evals/exports/alerts, and independent hands-on corroboration of the background evaluators.
